title: Specification conflict resolutions (#265 exact matrix wins) and the AgentState release edges
problem: #262/#264 prose and the #265 exact matrices disagree in places, and #265 section 12 has no path back to AVAILABLE for a worker slot whose task was withdrawn, transferred or cancelled.

options.summary: Use the #265 exact transition matrices and names; add Manager-only release edges

rationale: Resolutions: READY_FOR_REVIEW, MERGING and VERIFYING cannot transition directly to CANCELLED (HOLD can); the CAS error is REVISION_CONFLICT; Decision has a REJECTED state; Task has a HOLD state; LOST_RECOVERY is not a Task state (recovery is expressed as the owning agent LOST plus history.recoveryCount); objectId is the task id. Amendment: AgentState gains Manager-only release edges ASSIGNED->AVAILABLE, PREPARING->AVAILABLE, WORKING->AVAILABLE, WAITING_EXTERNAL->AVAILABLE and BLOCKED->AVAILABLE, taken only by the engine when the slot holds no remaining active work. Workers can never take these edges.
